question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

Suspend all the employees __which has been comin__g late.
solution:
The correct answer is **"who have been coming."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part of the sentence contains an error in subject-verb agreement.
 
• **"Employees"** is a plural noun, so the helping verb should also be plural i.e. **'have'.**
 
• In this case, **"who"** is used instead of** "which" **because **"employees"** refers to people, and** "who"** is used to refer to people while **"which"** is used to refer to things or animals. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

**The correct sentence would be:** *"Suspend all the employees **who have been coming**__ late."*
